products.name: PST Trend Indicator
products.description:
The best trend-detection indicator in the world, built on Mehrad Irani's eleven years of professional experience in Forex and Cryptocurrency markets. PST analyzes every layer of the market using a multi-timeframe matrix and shows you exactly why its analysis is trustworthy.

With real-time entry and exit lines displayed directly on the chart, PST gives you the confidence to enter trades with zero hesitation.

Additionally, by following a strict 1:2 risk-to-reward ratio, PST protects your capital automatically. You only set your account usage, and PST handles the analysis and risk management for you.

This is the ultimate indicator for traders who want accuracy, confidence, and professional-level risk control.
